tips.li: A Nemesis is a named antagonist, not a faceless raid. Capture, kill, or outlast them — or they win if their fixation target dies.
When they taunt over the comms console, you can reply: taunt back, offer a temporary truce, or demand surrender.
As the hunt escalates, intel scraps can reveal a camp site on the world map. It may be real, empty, or a trap.
Before removing Nemesis mid-save, use Mod Settings → Resolve current hunt now so WorldPawn pins are released.
